# ACK multi-packet stress designed to have many disjoint intervals.
import sys,time,json,subprocess
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
from wire import *
# 4096 packets each with 500 singleton ACK ranges = ~2.048m pairs, wire ~4MB +
N=4096;M=500
ev=[]
for i in range(N):
 body=bytearray(b'\x02')
 # ranges at PNs [j*10000]? Arbitrary disjoint singles via count pairs descending maybe complex.
 # Make ack frame with 'first' single and many pair singles descending from base.
 base=(M+1)*(i+1)*2
 body+=v(base)+v(0)+v(M-1)+v(0)
 for j in range(M-1):body+=b'\x00\x00'
 ev.append(datagram(envelope('I',i,bytes(body)),(0,)))
tr=trace(ev);inp=json.dumps({'traces':[tr]});print('input',len(inp))
t=time.time();p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/workspace/run.py','/workspace/tmp/classes'],input=inp.encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=180);print('elapsed',time.time()-t,'rc',p.returncode,'out',len(p.stdout),'err',p.stderr[:500])
if p.returncode==0:
 o=json.loads(p.stdout)['traces'][0];print(o['acknowledged'][0])
